The directional movement of the viewer’s vehicle is controlled by keyboard inputs, which steer the perspective, allowing the road geometry to smoothly curve and incorporate gentle changes in alignment as the journey continues.

statement: This sketch creates a retro-styled, dynamic road perspective using p5.js in WEBGL mode. Viewers experience a sense of motion as the road curves and changes direction beneath them, simulating the feeling of driving through a countryside landscape. The viewer controls steering with left/right arrow keys, which smoothly curves the perspective to create an immersive effect. The road features lane markings, roadside details, and branching side paths that give depth and a sense of continuous travel. The implementation uses a fixed number of road segments that move toward the viewer, creating an illusion of motion while maintaining performance within strict frame budget constraints. All visual elements are drawn in real-time with no external libraries, relying solely on p5.js's WEBGL capabilities to achieve the dynamic perspective effect.
